candidate_order_basis: EE-W4 harness default CANDIDATE_IDS and EE-R2E candidate-order neutrality qualification; R6B freezes A,B,C for the final package

cell_expansion_law.EXACT_IMMUTABLE_UPSTREAM_W4_PROFILE: expand the pinned EE-R3E profile steps byte-for-byte and in their existing order
cell_expansion_law.R6A_SPLICE: after acceptance, each WVS7 OP003-OP006 slot becomes one cold EXECUTE step in its fixed ordinal using the same reference-oracle materialization law
cell_expansion_law.REFERENCE_ORACLE_EXECUTION_PROFILE: one cold EXECUTE step per OP001-OP006 ready cell after candidate-independent oracle materialization; no synthetic warm repetitions

fail_closed_rules: workload operation/version or universe/source identity mismatch => reject assembly
missing reference oracle or pinned lifecycle oracle profile => reject assembly
reference oracle not materialized before candidate output => reject run as oracle-unfrozen
semantic oracle mismatch => performance-ineligible regardless of timing
missing required source-open/decode telemetry => measurement-incomplete, never zero
Candidate C accelerator set other than exactly CACC1+CACC2 => reject
Candidate A or B accelerator declaration => reject
candidate-specific omitted cell, altered request, step order, semantic branch, or reset => reject
WVS7/LiTS row, denominator, metric, or weight pooling => reject

oracle_gate.identity_oracle: all requested exact identities must pass
oracle_gate.reference_oracle_materialization: must complete before any candidate invocation for that step and be candidate-independent
oracle_gate.semantic_output_sha256: exact lowercase SHA-256 equality required by EE-W4

repetition_law.OP001_OP006: exactly one cold candidate execution per selected universe×operation cell; EEW1-OP023 is the separate warm/repeated-query operation and is not part of the frozen 18-cell selection floor
repetition_law.OP020_OP022: no R6B-generated repetition; preserve exactly the repetitions/actions/phases in each pinned EE-R3E profile
repetition_law.warm_1_warm_2_warm_5: not synthesized for OP001-OP006 by EE-R6B

reset_and_state_law: Each candidate has its own isolated scratch/durable/log/request/response roots as required by EE-W4.
A candidate never reuses another candidate's scratch or durable state.
EE-R6B inserts no reset between ordinary OP001-OP006 cells; doing so would redesign the frozen workload.
For OP020-OP022, every RESET_CANDIDATE_STATE / invalidation / replay boundary in the pinned EE-R3E profile is preserved exactly; no reset is added or removed.
The authoritative survey source and immutable side authority remain external/read-only across RESET_CANDIDATE_STATE.
No state, denominator, row set, metric, or cache is pooled across WVS7 and LiTS-I.
